catatan: Uji v3.85 (owner 15:40): satu adegan 28 detik, gerak bebas, dipecah otomatis jadi klip yang disambung last frame. Baju sama dengan foto acuan (tanpa pakaian) supaya sambungan tidak hanyut.
lokasi: A bright, tidy Indonesian family living room in the afternoon: a wooden front door on the left, a beige sofa in the center, a low wooden coffee table, a wooden chair by the door, a window with sunlight on the right, a small potted plant.

shots.title: Pulang sekolah
shots.adegan: Uwais stands just inside the open wooden front door on the left, a black backpack on his shoulders, sunlight behind him.
shots.adegan_lanjut: Uwais is in the bright family living room, the same afternoon, same clothes.

alur.aksi: Uwais closes the wooden door behind him with his right hand and steps into the room.
He slides the backpack off his shoulders and hangs it on the wooden chair by the door.
He walks across the room toward the sofa with relaxed, tired steps.
He stretches both arms up over his head in a long, slow stretch, rolling his shoulders.
He drops down onto the sofa and leans back into the cushions with a big relieved sigh, arms resting on the backrest.
He sits up straight again, rests his hands on his knees and nods to himself, ready to get up.

shots.kamera: medium wide shot at eye level, slow pan following Uwais
shots.akhir: Uwais sits upright on the sofa with his hands on his knees.
shots.latar: A calm afternoon living room: a wall clock ticking, birds outside, a distant motorbike, quiet room tone.

foley.suara: a wooden front door closing softly

benda.akhir: hanging on the wooden chair by the door
